create_Scene: create a Scene instance with a bullet client, gravity, timestep, and frame skip parameters
test_Scene_test_window: test the Scene test_window method to check if the PyBullet GUI window is still open
build_SingleRobotEmptyScene: build a SingleRobotEmptyScene subclass for single robot environments like InvertedPendulum or Reacher
run_World_step: run the World step method to advance the PyBullet physics simulation by one step
review_Scene_episode_restart: review the Scene episode_restart method to reset objects and clean the physics world
